hypothesis: Persistent same-direction top-five depth imbalance and aggressive trade-flow imbalance predict the 60-second BTCUSDT perpetual mid-price sufficiently to improve passive quote selection after realistic queue nonfills and adverse selection.

data.source: Binance public depth@100ms, aggTrade, and REST depth snapshots
data.local_book_rule: official U/u/pu sequence synchronization with resnapshot on every gap
data.calibration: next 3 complete UTC collection days; operational validation only

fixed_signal.quote: post-only at same-direction best bid or best ask

pre_sample_amendments.sample_state: 0 complete days; the sole incomplete-day signal remains excluded
pre_sample_amendments.reason: remove two optimistic execution assumptions before any development sample exists
changes: all decisions and flow windows use local received_at availability rather than exchange event time
taker exit markout uses executable best bid for a long and best ask for a short instead of mid-price
signal spacing and flow state continue across hourly collector chunk boundaries
+100ms latency order time is the first locally available book update after the latency boundary
the evaluator streams previous/current/next chunks so five-minute horizons are preserved without loading the full campaign into RAM

pre_sample_amendments.sample_state: 0 complete days; all seven incomplete-day signals remain excluded
pre_sample_amendments.reason: remove a mixed-clock missing-data check before any development sample exists
changes: future markout gap validation uses local received_at availability, matching the decision and fill clock
each future run records collector, order-book, evaluator, fill-model, and preregistration SHA-256 fingerprints; mixed protocol versions inside evaluated complete days fail closed
each future run compares UTC active duration with monotonic active duration and fails the chunk when clock drift or sleep exceeds the fixed five-percent-or-five-second tolerance
campaign preflight requires a healthy five-minute canary whose complete protocol fingerprint matches the current collector and evaluator

prohibited: using candle touches as maker fills
opening the locked period before development and calibration are sealed
claiming the hypothesis is profitable before the locked gate has enough fills
submitting live orders during this study
research_basis: Cartea, Donnelly, and Jaimungal: order-book imbalance can improve quote placement by reducing adverse selection
Stoikov: microprice adjusts mid-price using touch imbalance
Binance USD-M official local-order-book synchronization rules
